title: Check cold and quiescent idle scan boundaries in the terminal-retention probe
outcome: The rescan diagnostic distinguishes actual initial and quiescent idle scans and identifies change or publication work included in the measurements.
acceptance: The probe establishes the expected cold and idle origin independently of the origin it passes to refresh, and checks publication success and idle change counts or flags samples with follow-up work.
It reports actual phase spans and the test-build fixture scope without thresholds tied to a host's performance or asserting the Central live criterion.
